title: 2020-2025 Explorer: click or pop turning the wheel to full lock at low speed, front upper strut mount
summary: Ford TSB 25-2213: a click/pop when turning from straight ahead to full lock at low speed, from the front upper strut mount washer moving under steering load. Confirm it on the ground with the engine running, then replace the upper strut mount(s).

specs.name: Lower strut-to-knuckle bolts
specs.value: W715932-S439 standard, or W715295-S439 with eccentric cam (camber)

specs.name: Labor
specs.value: 1.5 hr one side, 2.1 hr both; +1.4 hr alignment (1.6 hr with lane departure)

steps.text: Vehicle on the ground, engine running: turn from straight ahead to full lock both ways and watch and listen at the upper strut mounts. No movement or noise there: diagnose per WSM 204-01B instead.
Remove and disassemble the front strut and spring assembly on the affected side(s), replace the upper strut mount, and reassemble and install per WSM 204-01B.
Check and adjust front camber, caster and toe.

sources.title: TSB 25-2213: Click/Pop Noise While Turning The Steering Wheel From Straight Ahead To Full Lock During Low Speed Turning Events
